name: Ring Push-Up
steps: Adjust a pair of gymnastic rings just above the floor, grip both rings firmly, and step your feet back into a rigid straight plank position.
Brace your core and glutes tightly while stabilizing the rings directly beneath your shoulders.
Bend your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle from your ribs to lower your chest slowly between the rings into a controlled chest stretch.
Press powerfully through the rings to extend your arms back to lockout, turning the rings slightly outward at the top.
tips: Keep the rings pulled close to your body line instead of letting them drift wide during the push.
Avoid rubbing your forearms heavily against the straps for balance; stabilize cleanly through your shoulders and core.
